name: Rules for Ontology
description: Rules for Ontology integrate with Fabric Activator so teams can monitor business entities and configure event-driven alerts. Users can define alerts against properties across instances of an entity type and use the resulting notifications or automated actions to respond to operational conditions. This helps operators monitor their business model without recreating its context in separate alert definitions. This entry records the previously shipped release; subsequent rule authoring, agent-query, and monitoring updates have separate milestones.
